description.value: At 1st level, the monk rigorously trains his body in fitness and enduring physical pain, allowing him to shrug off blows that would normally prove fatal to others. He gains an extra amount of maximum hit points equal to his monk level multiplied by his Constitution bonus (ex: a 5th level monk with a +4 Constitution modifier would have +20 to his maximum hit points as a result of this ability). Additionally, if the monk picks up the Toughness feat, it instead grants him a +5 hit points and +1 hit point per level.
